finish-args-flatpak-system-folder-export: A Flatpak-installed app's icon is exported here and nowhere a sandbox can otherwise read. Flatpak binds the host's own icon themes for free but not its own exports. Read-only.
finish-args-unnecessary-xdg-data-flatpak: As above, for apps the user installed rather than the system.
finish-args-only-wayland: The app is a Wayland client end to end, talking the protocol directly. There is no X11 path to fall back to.
appstream-external-screenshot-url: Screenshots are mirrored by Flathub's own build, so this cannot pass anywhere else.
